nodes.label: spl_autoload_register closure with class_exists retry loop (12/09)
nodes.rationale: Adds a for-loop (max 2 attempts) that, after including the file resolved for a class/interface/trait, calls class_exists()/interface_exists()/trait_exists() via eval() to verify the type actually became defined; if not, it unsets the stale PID_CLASS_REGISTER entry and retries a fresh filesystem search. Design intent: guard against a cached registry entry pointing to a file that no longer defines the expected type (e.g. renamed/moved class), so autoloading self-heals instead of silently failing or throwing a fatal 'class not found' error.
